feed.title: Writing by Nabarun Sarkar
feed.subtitle: Notes on machine learning, robotics, agent infrastructure and blockchain.

entry.title: Speaker fingerprinting: how voice AI tells people apart
entry.summary: What a voiceprint actually is, the model lineage that produces it (i-vectors, d-vectors, x-vectors, ECAPA-TDNN, trained on VoxCeleb), how enrollment and scoring work, and where fingerprinting breaks, including spoofing.

entry.title: The KV cache and the long-context race
entry.summary: A history of the KV cache in LLMs: why it exists, the papers that shrank it, the position tricks that stretched context, and how windows grew from 2,000 tokens to a million.

entry.title: The machinery of attention: a reading list from IISc's Centre for Neuroscience
entry.summary: The selected papers from Sridharan Devarajan's Cognition, Computation and Behavior Lab, summarized and linked: the two components of attention, how it separates from expectation and reward, and deep learning for medical images.

entry.title: The HiRo Lab reading list: robots that learn from people
entry.summary: A summary of every paper on IISc's HiRo Lab research page, grouped by the five threads the lab pulls on: interactive RL, foundation models, safe human-robot interaction, optimal control, and 3D vision.
